trap.label: can’t be × can’t have been
trap.wrong: It can’t have been true now, but it can’t be Leo yesterday.
trap.right: It can’t be true now, but it can’t have been Leo yesterday.
trap.why: O português usa “não pode ser” para ambos. Em inglês, presente = can’t be; passado = can’t have been.

mcq.q: He is here now. He ___ be sick.

fix.right: It can’t have been Leo yesterday.

fix.wrong: It can’t have been true now.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o passado: “It can’t be Leo.”
Passe para o presente: “It can’t have been the battery.”
Reescreva com can’t: “It is impossible that she was angry.”
